name: FU shared hobby core operational rehearsal
limitations: Loopback HTTP and provider emulator; real SMS handsets and carrier routing are untested.
Synthetic venue access and self check-ins do not establish real participation.
Sixty seconds of sustained requests is a bounded rehearsal, not long-term availability evidence.
Restore is checked at a quiescent backup checkpoint; production backup RPO is not established.
Configuration rollback is exercised; arbitrary future schema and code upgrades require new qualification.
Equipment receiver reports are simulated HTTP inputs; physical tag detection, RF coverage, zone accuracy and background scanning are untested.
Scores and result corrections are human-reported; no autonomous physical refereeing or sport federation certification is claimed.
The mesh remains a reference kernel; no physical peer network is included.
